entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane of five shards that have converged into one multicolored plane.

entities.name: Revin Skoros
entities.description: A once-brilliant human æthermage of Grixis, now one of the Damned, who corrupts mana wherever he goes.

entities.name: Ranalus
entities.description: A vedalken scholar of Palandius who renounced Esper and removed her etherium among the coatls of Naya.

entities.name: Haaach
entities.description: A ferocious, fast Jund goblin warrior of the Bloodhall wanted for war-law violations on Bant.

entities.name: Dollun Spinebreaker
entities.description: A rhox Knight-Captain of the army of Jhess who snapped after his legion was slaughtered in Naya.

entities.name: Banath'thur
entities.description: A demon imprisoned by Vithians of Grixis who broke free during the Conflux and enslaves souls.

entities.name: Thunder Thrash
entities.description: A primitive, bloodthirsty viashino clan of Jund that illicitly installed etherium in Esper.

entities.name: Jkkhah
entities.description: The elder who led the Thunder Thrash to the etherium storehouse.

entities.name: Sarrasa
entities.description: An Amesha-rank angel who guarded the castle Giltspire and deserted it before the Conflux.

entities.name: Sharuum
entities.description: The Sphinx Hegemon of Esper who once scolded Ranalus.

entities.name: Eleventh Legion
entities.description: A Bant legion of soldiers, Sigiled paladins and leotau cavalry commanded by Dollun.

entities.name: Army of Jhess
entities.description: The Bant army on the Jhess coast in which Dollun served.

entities.name: Giltspire
entities.description: A holy castle site on Bant guarded by Sarrasa.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: A Bant nation where the Battle of the Bloody Gate took place.

entities.name: Bloodhall
entities.description: Possibly Jund's deepest geothermic cavern system, home of Haaach's goblin warren.

entities.name: Qasal
entities.description: A Nacatl city near a jungle shrine that was the source of the ceremonial dagger.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: The shard where Vithians imprisoned Banath'thur.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: The shard of etherium where Ranalus lived and the Thunder Thrash raided.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The jungle shard where Ranalus renounced Esper and Dollun's legion was slaughtered.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: A Naya pride of cat-people enslaved by Banath'thur.

entities.name: Vithians
entities.description: Astute human Vithians of Grixis who imprisoned Banath'thur and were later enslaved by him.

events.summary: Banath'thur tempts the æthermage Revin Skoros with exotic mana bonds, and Skoros becomes one of the Damned.
events.quote: If the demon Banath'thur hadn't tempted Skoros with promises of exotic new bonds to sources of mana

events.summary: Ranalus renounces Esper and the Filigree Texts while undercover in the jungles of Naya.
events.quote: she made the decision to renounce Esper and to repudiate the principles of the Filigree Texts

events.summary: Ranalus extracts all her etherium while a coatl offers its regenerative powers.
events.quote: she extracted every thread and joint of etherium from her body

events.summary: Haaach is last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate, believed responsible for over twenty deaths.
events.quote: Haaach was last seen at the Battle of the Bloody Gate in Valeron

events.summary: Dollun Spinebreaker's Eleventh Legion is slaughtered in Naya.
events.quote: Dollun saw his men slain by the hundreds on a long and chaotic campaign into Naya

events.summary: Dollun emerges in tribal garb with two spiked maces, butchers nearby Naya and Jund enemies, and flees into a Jund chasm.
events.quote: Dollun emerged from his tent in tribal garb, blood-spattered and wielding two massive spiked maces

events.summary: Vithians imprison Banath'thur in vaults under their hermitage.
events.quote: The demon Banath'thur was imprisoned by astute Vithian humans of Grixis.

events.summary: The Conflux breaks Banath'thur's bindings and he enslaves the Vithians and a Nacatl pride.
events.quote: Banath'thur turned the Vithians and the nearby Nacatl pride into his own personal minions

events.summary: The Thunder Thrash raids Esper and attacks an etherium storehouse under Jkkhah.
events.quote: their elder Jkkhah led the thrash to attack a facility that turned out to be a temporary wartime storehouse for etherium

events.summary: The Thunder Thrash emerges with illicit etherium enhancements and destroys the Esper strike force.
events.quote: the Thunder Thrash emerged, strange etherium enhancements suffusing their muscular frames

events.summary: Sarrasa deserts Giltspire before the Conflux began.
events.quote: Sarrasa deserted the castle for reasons unknown.

relations.note: Banath'thur tempted Skoros into becoming one of the Damned.
relations.quote: If the demon Banath'thur hadn't tempted Skoros with promises of exotic new bonds to sources of mana
had commanded the Eleventh Legion of soldiers, Sigiled paladins, and leotau cavalry

relations.note: Dollun was a foremost rhox champion of the army.
relations.quote: one of the foremost rhox champions of the army of Jhess

relations.note: Jkkhah is the elder who led the thrash.
relations.quote: their elder Jkkhah led the thrash
was once scolded by the Sphinx Hegemon, Sharuum herself

relations.note: Haaach is thought to originate from the goblin warren of the Bloodhall.
relations.quote: Haaach is thought to have originated from the warren of Jund goblins
